title: Agent Registry Entry
description: Schema for registry.yaml files that track active agents in the ST Agent Registry

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for the agent (matches directory name)

type.description: Entity type: active (true agent with CLAUDE.md) or passive (prompt template persona)

registered_at.description: ISO date when agent was registered

source_path.description: Path to the runtime source of truth for this agent's config

last_synced_at.description: ISO date of last sync from registry to runtime

sync_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the agent's CLAUDE.md at last sync

learning.description: Learning loop metadata for Sky-Lynx patch tracking

last_patch_at.description: ISO date of last applied patch
